# Garden handbook

# Heading at level 1

Maps larger than the tables are kept flat in the plan chest. The north bed holds the early beans and two rows of lettuce.

## Heading at level 2

Water reaches each plot through a drip line laid under the mulch. Volunteers record rainfall every morning before the gate opens.

### Heading at level 3

The tool shed keeps spades, forks and a wheelbarrow with a spare tyre. Compost is turned once a week and covered when frost is forecast.

#### Heading at level 4

A rain barrel at each corner collects water from the shelter roof. Seedlings start in the cold frame and move out after the last frost.

##### Heading at level 5

Paths between the beds are wide enough for a wheelbarrow to pass. The bench by the pond is a good place to sort seed packets.

###### Heading at level 6

Each season ends with a shared meal and a swap of saved seeds. The lighthouse lamp turns once every twelve seconds.

# Second chapter

## Back to level two

Keepers logged the wind direction at the top of every hour. A brass barometer hangs beside the stairs to the lantern room.
